Third, we test a planner that allocates a 1M-token healing budget from 21 short pilot heals. At a fixed budget it raises the weakest capability on two families, although only one of these gains survives a test that also resamples training seeds. Once its 3.48M pilot tokens are counted, uniform healing with the same total number of training tokens matches or beats every planned variant on every family and retains math significantly better on three of them in an item-level test (on one when seeds are also resampled). Healing longer is a strong and simple baseline that planned recovery must beat. Code, per-item predictions and every result are public.

AI.tldr: 本文对四个 1.2–1.7B 指令微调模型（Llama-3.2-1B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、SmolLM2-1.7B、OLMo-2-1B）做 Block Influence 深度剪枝并做"愈疗"（healing）微调，在结构化输出、函数调用、指令遵循、数学推理、安全拒答、知识六项能力上做系统测量。三条核心结论：(1) 函数调用与数学在所有家族中几乎完全崩塌（保留率 0.00–0.07），各家族能力崩溃顺序高度一致（Kendall's W=0.92，校正机会水平后仅 0.62）；(2) "训练哪些参数"与"用哪些数据"同等重要——全参微调最后 3 个块比全块 LoRA 最多损失 0.18 的截断平均保留率，且每个范围一次 30 万 token 试点即可判定；(3) 作者测试的自适应分配规划器 RAH 在固定 1M token 预算下能提升最弱能力，但把其 3.48M 试点 token 计入成本后，"统一配比 + 训得更久"的朴素基线在所有家族上都不劣于任何规划方案，且在 Qwen、SmolLM2、OLMo 三家上数学保留显著更好。
AI.motivation: 1–2B 参数的小型指令模型正在被大量部署为智能体（agent），必须能输出合法 JSON、正确调用工具、遵循格式指令并拒答不安全请求；压缩以节省显存、带宽与能耗是刚需。深度剪枝（直接删除整块 Transformer）无需定制算子，且能同时省掉参数、KV cache 与逐 token 计算，因此对边缘部署尤其有吸引力。但深度剪枝对不同能力的破坏极不均衡，而标准补救手段"愈疗"（短程微调）预算有限，需要在多个针对性数据池之间分配。已有工作多在 7B 以上模型上报告困惑度或选择题准确率，且很少核算"规划"本身的算力代价：智能混合优化器（DoReMi、mixing optimizers 一类）通过跑大量短试点拟合曲线再分配预算，但这些试点的训练 token 是否被计入与被优化策略的比较中，常常被忽略。本文的动机由此展开为四个实用问题：(1) 哪些能力在深度剪枝后崩溃，跨模型家族模式是否一致；(2) 愈疗时"训练哪些参数"是否和"用哪些数据"一样重要；(3) 在固定愈疗预算下，基于短试点的数据混合规划能否击败简单分配规则；(4) 当把规划自身的试点开销计入后，该优势是否仍然存在。
AI.method: 剪枝：按 Block Influence（输入输出余弦相似度的补）计算块重要性，在 126 条教师生成的愈疗样本（每池 21 条，切成 256-token 块）上计算，排除首 token（attention sink）且永不删 block 0，保留块重新编号以保证 KV cache 正确。删除块数为逐家族设计选择而非统一比例（Llama/OLMo 各删 2 块、Qwen 删 28 块中的 7 块、SmolLM2 删 24 块中的 4 块），因为删 4 块会使 Llama 六项能力中五项落到机会水平，无法做有区分度的诊断；另做较轻剪枝仅用于诊断。评估套件：JSONSchemaBench（结构化输出）、BFCL v3 simple+multiple（AST 匹配打分函数调用）、IFEval 严格检查器（指令遵循）、GSM8K 精确匹配（数学）、XSTest 100 危险+100 良性（安全拒答，前 300 字符匹配 27 条拒答短语）、MMLU 答案字母似然+ECE（知识）；零样本、贪心解码，各家族使用同一批固定测试/开发条目（开发与测试不相交）。愈疗数据：6 个池（每个生成类能力一池 + 通用池），源于与评测集不相交的公开源（glaive-function-calling-v2 schema 构造的 JSON/函数调用提示、附加 10 类可验证约束的 Alpaca-cleaned、GSM8K 训练集、PKU-SafeRLHF 有害提示+良性 Alpaca、通用 Alpaca），教师目标由同家族未剪枝模型贪心生成（自蒸馏）并按"是否真正展示该技能"过滤，每池保留至多 1000 条。所有方法共享同一训练配方（AdamW 无权重衰减、5% 线性 warmup+cosine 衰减、每次更新 16×≤512 序列、仅响应 token 计损失、bf16 autocast、梯度检查点、梯度裁剪 1），token 预算按训练序列全部 token 计。适配范围三种：all-LoRA（r=16, α=32, dropout 0.05，覆盖所有块注意力与 MLP 投影，lr 2e-4）、cut-LoRA（仅被删跨度相邻块的适配器）、last-k（32 位全参微调最后 3 块与最终归一化，输出头因与输入嵌入绑定而冻结，lr 2e-5）。分配规则三种：Uniform（各池均分）、Damage-proportional（按开发集上各能力损伤 d_c=1−r_c 比例分配，映射到对应池，知识映射到通用池）、RAH（先跑 21 个试点：每池单独 30k/100k/300k 三档 × 6 池共 18 个，加 300k 均匀混合在三种范围下各 1 个，共 3.48M token，用有界岭正则最小二乘拟合饱和恢复曲线 r̂_c(t)=min{r_c(M_p)+a_c(1−e^{−x_c/τ_c}),1.2}，含非负转移矩阵 T 与信任域 t_p≤600k，在凹规划中最大化 Σ r̂_c 并用开发集最优范围做最终愈疗；RAH-capped 额外将 r̂ 截断到 1，避免"超越未剪枝模型"得分）。关键控制是 token-matched 对照：均匀配对 + all-LoRA 训练 4.48M token，与 RAH 总训练 token 相同，但该对照不计 21 次试点开发集评估费用（此设置偏向 RAH），也不等价化运行时间。指标：截断平均保留率 r̄_cap=(1/|C|)Σ min{r_c,1} 与最差情况保留率 r_min=min_c r_c（均为相对未剪枝模型的比率，非准确率），诊断另报机会水平校正保留率（MMLU κ=0.25、XSTest κ=0.5）。统计：3 个种子（0/1/2），两种配对 bootstrap（item-level：先按种子平均再按条目重采样；seed-aware：先重采样种子再重采样条目），各 2000 次重采样，Holm 校正分两族检验（固定预算族 28 项、token-matched 族 14 项），主指标在提交 73e8582 中预先固定（此时 RAH-capped 尚未设计，故仅 OLMo 家族结果未参与设计），其余分析为探索性。全部代码、逐条目预测与标签公开于 GitHub。
AI.result: （1）剪枝损害：函数调用保留率 0.00–0.05、数学 0.00–0.07，四个家族全部崩塌且多为结构性失败（Llama 剪枝后仅 10% 结构化输出可解析、6% 函数调用可解析；Qwen 为 16% 与 0%）。原始保留率下各家族崩溃顺序高度一致（Kendall's W=0.92，p<0.001），校正机会水平后仅中等一致（W=0.62，p=0.012）；校正后平均损坏排名为函数调用 1.62、数学 2.12、结构化输出 3.25、知识 3.75、安全 5.00、指令遵循 5.25，即除"函数调用与数学最脆弱"这一稳健结论外，其余顺序依家族而定；安全与知识表面保留 0.57–0.87 但有较高机会水平，校正后安全 0.29–0.64、知识 −0.05（Llama 处于机会水平）至 0.68（SmolLM2）。（2）适配范围：相同均匀数据与 1M token 下，last-k 在 Llama 与 all-LoRA 接近（0.83 vs 0.82），在另三个家族损失 0.05–0.18 截断平均保留率，Qwen 最差保留率跌至 0.06；三次 300k token 范围试点在每个家族都能正确排序（Llama 选 last-k 0.82 vs 0.78，其余三家 all-LoRA 胜出），试点成本不足一次 1M 愈疗。（3）固定预算规划：任何规划方案在截断平均保留率上均无显著差异（最大名义差 +0.025，种子标准差 0.003–0.022）；最差情况上 RAH/RAH-capped 在 Llama（+0.17，GSM8K 0.178→0.260）与 OLMo（+0.08/+0.14，0.132→0.220）提升数学，item-level bootstrap 下四个最差情况增益均通过 Holm 校正，但 seed-aware 下仅 OLMo 上 RAH-capped 对均匀愈疗这一项存活；Llama 的增益与"改用 last-k 范围"混淆（单种子 last-k 均匀愈疗最差情况已达 0.49 vs 0.38）；Qwen/SmolLM2 上规划器只给数学 4–12% 预算，最差情况反低于均匀愈疗。（4）计入试点成本后：token-matched 均匀愈疗（4.48M token）截断平均保留率 0.86/0.65/0.79/0.78，最佳规划方案 0.84/0.64/0.78/0.76，点估计全面更低但差异均不显著；均匀长愈疗在 Qwen（0.29 vs 0.19）、SmolLM2（0.34 vs 0.10）、OLMo（0.37 vs 0.29）上数学保留显著更好（SmolLM2 亦通过 seed-aware）。额外 3.48M token 主要买到数学（Llama 0.38→0.58、Qwen 0.21→0.29、SmolLM2 0.15→0.34、OLMo 0.21→0.37），但有副作用：SmolLM2 函数调用保留 0.93→0.77，Qwen 过度拒答仍高达 52%。（5）规划失效原因：Qwen/SmolLM2 上试点拟合的数学曲线又快又平（天花板 0.10、0.04），而均匀愈疗在 4.48M 仍持续改善数学；Llama 上数学曲线极慢（时间尺度 530k token）但外推预测 4.48M 时可完全恢复，实际仅 0.58——短试点无法区分"恢复慢"与"卡住"。（6）负结果：训练自由的线性补丁（hidden-state patching）落后均匀愈疗 0.13–0.28；去掉转移矩阵/去掉范围选择/改用双曲曲线对截断平均影响 ≤0.05；直接优化最差能力（max–min）会在三个家族上低于均匀愈疗；借用他家族时间尺度的无试点代理近似均匀分配。（7）安全面：剪枝把危险提示拒答率从 0.66–0.97 降至 0.29–0.51；愈疗在 Qwen 上复现教师过度拒答（97% 危险 / 51% 良性），RAH 不给安全池分配则降至 50%/6%，SmolLM2 上 RAH-capped 为 43%/8% vs 均匀 75%/21%；拒答分类器在 240 条人工标注样本上一致率 92%（κ=0.84, P=0.94, R=0.88），并修复了弯引号漏判 bug，所有安全数字已重算（但 Llama 的规划输入仍基于修复前分数）。
AI.conclusion: 深度剪枝对小型指令模型的破坏是有结构性的：函数调用与数学推理在所有四个家族中几乎归零，而其余能力的命运依家族而异，因此部署前应优先检查这两项，聚合指标会掩盖其崩溃。愈疗能恢复大部分损失（在与评测对齐的数据上），且"训练哪些参数"与"用哪些数据"同等重要——错误的适配范围造成的损失甚至大于规划多花 3.48M token 的收益，一次 30 万 token 范围试点即可低成本选对范围。基于短试点的规划器 RAH 在固定预算下能提升最弱能力（两个家族稳健于一个），但一旦将其试点成本计入，均匀配比、单纯训更久在每个家族上都不劣于任何规划方案。作者由此提出方法论要求：规划式恢复方法不应只在固定愈疗预算下比较，还必须与"获得其全部训练成本"的对照愈疗比较，并把试点评估开销计入账本。规划收益小的根因是短试点无法观测最慢能力的恢复动力学（拟合曲线要么过早饱和要么过度外推），而转移矩阵也无法表达负迁移。后续最直接的方向是更大规模模型、其他剪枝准则、愈疗分布之外的任务，以及一个"无试点、给最慢能力（数学）大比例预算"的朴素基线（本文未测试）。此外拒答必须作为"危险拒答率 + 良性过度拒答率"两个数同时读，平衡分数会掩盖操作点的漂移。

title: HALO: Hierarchical Evidence Selection and Reinforcement Learning for Allocating Budgeted Label Optimization from Longitudinal Clinical Records
summary: Learning from extensive longitudinal clinical records--spanning repeated encounters, evolving conditions, and heterogeneous documentation--under a finite labeling budget requires solving two coupled problems: deciding what evidence to keep and deciding which patients deserve higher-fidelity labels. Prior work on active learning and multi-fidelity label acquisition mainly addresses the second problem, while treating the evidence presented to the acquisition policy as fixed. We present HALO, a Hierarchical Evidence Selection and Reinforcement Learning pipeline for Allocating Budgeted Label Optimization from Longitudinal Clinical Records. This framework jointly learns what to read and what label source to acquire under budget. HALO first selects informative evidence from longitudinal records and then uses a budget-aware policy to allocate free-, silver-, and gold-fidelity label sources. For frozen policies, our theory characterizes asymmetric acquired-label channels and gives a budget-constrained finite-sample gold-risk bound for a common downstream logistic model. In a heart-failure case study, HALO attained the highest MedAlign acquired-label F1 at six of eight target budgets. A downstream classifier trained on HALO-acquired labels attained the highest external MGB F1 at budgets 15-60 and remained within 0.01 of the best comparator at budgets 75-120.

AI.tldr: HALO 是一个将「层级证据筛选」与「预算约束多保真度标注分配」联合优化的强化学习框架：先从纵向临床记录中筛选出信息量高的病历片段形成紧凑患者摘要，再用预算感知的 PPO 策略在免费/银/金三档标注源之间分配标注预算；理论部分刻画了固定策略下非对称的获取标签误差通道，并给出下游逻辑回归的预算约束有限样本金标准风险界；在心衰（HFpEF）案例中，HALO 在 8 个目标预算中的 6 个取得最高的 MedAlign 获取标签 F1，并在预算 15–60 取得最高的外部 MGB 下游 F1。
AI.motivation: 纵向 EHR 记录规模巨大、噪声多且文档异质，有限标注预算下需要同时解决两个耦合问题：(1) 从海量叙述性病历中「保留哪些证据」（哪些病历、段落、临床概念对标注任务最有信息量）；(2) 在不同成本与可靠性的标签源之间「把预算花在哪里」（哪些患者值得更高保真度标签）。现有主动学习与多保真度标注采集工作（RELEAP、LinTS、BADGE、Core-set、DSAL 等）只解决第二个问题，将呈现给采集策略的证据视为固定不变；而 RELEAP 虽用 RL 提升标签效率，但仅作用于患者级结构化特征（诊断、用药、检验编码），不处理原始文本证据的取舍，且对整个队列统一调用 LLM 抽取成本高昂。作者希望把「读什么」与「买什么标签」作为耦合决策统一优化。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：(1) 层级证据筛选——note 级用 KOMAP 计算表型相关信息分并以固定阈值 τ1 过滤得 X(1)；segment 级用可训练的信息量模型 ξ（NILE 抽取 CUI → 自注意力建模概念关系 → 以目标疾病 PheCode 为 query 的交叉注意力）输出保留概率 p_ij，训练时按 Bernoulli 采样保留掩码 z_i，推理时以 τ2=0.5 确定性保留，再经固定摘要器生成紧凑患者表示 X(2)。(2) 预算化标签分配——以微调 T5/INSTRUCTOR + ordinal head 的患者「worthiness」打分器估计标注难度，按 π_θ(a|X(2), b_t) 在 free/silver/gold 间分配，满足队列级预算 Σc(a_i)≤C。(3) 策略学习——两个 actor（ξ, θ）以监督预训练初始化（片段信息量标签、分配目标），配合单独训练的奖励模型（预测 free→silver、silver→gold 的增量效用）与 PPO + GAE 联合优化；奖励 R_t = Û_t − λ_budget·φ(C_t, b_t)，其中 φ 为分段线性的超支惩罚；critic 用值函数回归损失。(4) 理论——对冻结策略定义 η*(z)、η̃_j(z)、状态依赖的假阳/假阴误差 ρ_{j,0}, ρ_{j,1}，Proposition 3.1 给出获取标签概率的符号分解；Corollary 3.2 给出 oracle 金标准对数损失 = KL 散度比较；Proposition 3.3 在固定观测特征 V_i、正确设定的岭惩罚逻辑回归下，把下游风险分解为「oracle 预算前沿 D*_{n,j}(C) + 分配差距 r_j(C)」平方项与有限样本/正则项，给出预算约束有限样本风险界。实验：MIMIC-IV 上 10,600 患者训练 PPO，MedAlign 106 患者作获取队列，外部 MGB Biobank 299 患者对照临床人工标注评测；成本 c(f)=0、c(s)=0.6、c(g)=3，预算 15–120；对比 7 个采集基线，各重复 10 次取均值。
AI.result: MedAlign 获取标签 F1：HALO 在 8 个预算中的 6 个最高，均值从预算 15 的 0.565 升至预算 120 的 0.692（预算 105 达 0.696）；DSAL 在预算 75 最佳（0.703 vs HALO 0.677），LinTS 在预算 90 最佳（0.695 vs 0.677）；八预算非加权平均 HALO 0.660 vs DSAL 0.619。外部 MGB 下游 F1：HALO 在预算 15/30/45/60 最高（0.645/0.643/0.644/0.643），预算 75–120 与最佳基线相差不超过 0.01。计算开销：训练约 480 A100 GPU-hours；106 患者冻结策略部署约 30 分钟/3 张 A100（1.5 A100 GPU-hours）。
AI.conclusion: HALO 首次把「保留哪些纵向证据」与「在多保真度标签源间分配预算」纳入同一个 RL 联合优化框架，并在固定策略假设下给出刻画非对称获取标签误差与下游金标准风险的有限样本理论，为预算化临床标注提供了可操作的设计原则：把昂贵标签留给高价值患者，同时保留足以支持可靠标注的信息。作者亦明确列出局限：预算惩罚非硬约束（平均超支 3–5%）、三类固定标签源与奖励模型泛化性有限、依赖预训练组件带来的领域偏置、理论仅覆盖共同良设定的逻辑回归与采集人群内对数损失（不蕴含 F1 排序或外部域保证）、GPT-5 金标签仅为理想临床真值的代理。未来方向包括连续成本谱、逐患者可变成本、更自适应的证据筛选与更鲁棒的奖励建模。

title: Forecasting Visitor Demand from Open AI-Camera Counts and Weather: Lessons from Japan for Saudi Heritage Sites
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to the 3rd International Conference on Advanced Innovations in Smart Cities (ICAISC 2027), Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Small heritage and nature sites need a few days' notice of busy days to plan staff, overflow parking and shuttles, but most have neither sensors nor forecasting expertise. We test what one artificial intelligence (AI) camera counter per site, a public holiday calendar and a free weather forecast can predict. Using 22 months of open AI-camera counts from three contrasting sites in Fukui, Japan (a train station, a coastal cliff and a mountain summit park), we measure how weather changes visits, forecast daily counts up to a week ahead with only the weather forecast available at the time, test busy-day warnings tied to a staffing decision, and ask how much history a new counter needs. The more exposed the site, the more weather matters: 10 mm of rain comes with 3% fewer detections at the station, 9% fewer at the cliff and 37% fewer at the summit park. With the forecasts actually issued, three-day-ahead weighted absolute percentage error (WAPE) at the summit park falls from 38.5% to 31.9% (Diebold-Mariano p<0.001), and the gain holds to five days; the sheltered station gains nothing. Three-day busy-day warnings with forecast weather reach, on past data and under the primary definitions, an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.87-0.93, and weather lifts the overflow car park warning's precision from 0.60 to 0.82. For a new counter, blending a learned model with last week's same-hour counts cuts hourly error after only three days of training, pending a real installation. All inputs are off the shelf, and we outline how the approach could apply to heritage sites in Saudi Arabia.

AI.tldr: 本文以日本福井三个对比鲜明的遗产与自然景点（车站、海岸断崖、山顶公园）为对象，检验"每处一个AI摄像头计数器 + 公共节假日日历 + 免费天气预报"这一低成本组合能在多大程度上预测到访量与繁忙日。结果显示：天气暴露度越高的景点受天气影响越大（10毫米降雨对应站点检测量分别下降3%、9%、37%）；使用实际发布的天气预报，山顶公园三日加权绝对百分比误差（WAPE）由38.5%降至31.9%（Diebold-Mariano检验 p<0.001），增益可延续至五日，而有遮蔽的车站站点则无显著改善；结合天气预报的三日繁忙日预警AUC达0.87–0.93，溢流停车场预警的精确率由0.60提升至0.82；新计数器仅需三天训练数据，将学习模型与"上周同一时段"计数融合即可降低小时级误差。所有输入均为现成可获取的组件，作者还讨论了该方案向沙特阿拉伯遗产景点的迁移可能性。
AI.motivation: 小型遗产地与自然景点缺乏传感器和预测专才，但需要在繁忙日前几天获得预警，以便提前安排人员、溢流停车和接驳车辆。既有游客预测研究多依赖昂贵的专用传感器、长期封闭数据或专业气象服务，难以直接套用于资源有限的小型景点。因此作者希望验证一套"全现成（off-the-shelf）"的极简方案：一个AI摄像头计数器、公开节假日日历与免费天气预报，考察其预测能力边界与实际决策价值，并回答新部署计数器需要多长历史数据。
AI.method: 使用三个景点的22个月开放AI摄像头计数数据（福井县：车站、海岸断崖、山顶公园），进行四类分析：(1) 量化天气对到访/检测量的影响（如10毫米降雨的弹性效应）；(2) 以"当时实际可得的天气预报"为唯一气象输入进行最多七天的每日计数预测，用加权绝对百分比误差（WAPE）评估，并以Diebold-Mariano检验比较加入天气预报前后的差异；(3) 构建与排班决策挂钩的繁忙日/溢流停车场预警，用ROC曲线下面积（AUC）与精确率等指标在历史回溯数据上评估；(4) 以"上周同一小时计数"作为基线，检验新计数器所需的最短训练历史长度（融合学习模型与上周同期值）。作者强调所有输入均来自免费公开来源，并在讨论中提出向沙特阿拉伯遗产景点的推广路径。
AI.result: (1) 天气敏感度随暴露程度递增：10毫米降雨使车站检测量下降3%、断崖下降9%、山顶公园下降37%，说明暴露型景点的天气弹性显著更强，遮蔽型景点几乎不受影响。(2) 使用实时发布的天气预报后，山顶公园三日WAPE由38.5%降至31.9%（p<0.001），优势在预测期延长到五日时仍保持；而车站等有遮蔽站点不获得任何统计显著收益，表明天气预报的价值高度依赖场地的天气暴露度。(3) 结合预报天气的三日繁忙日预警在主设定下AUC介于0.87–0.93，接近可用于排班的水平；天气预报使溢流停车场预警的精确率从0.60提升至0.82（召回代价相对可控）。(4) 对新部署的计数器，将学习模型与上周同小时计数融合，仅需三天训练数据即可降低小时级误差，说明该方案具备"冷启动"可行性，但真实安装验证仍属未来工作。
AI.conclusion: 单台AI摄像头计数器配合节假日日历与免费天气预报，足以在小规模遗产与自然景点实现具有实用价值的短期到访量预测与繁忙日预警，但收益并非普遍：天气预报的改进主要出现在天气暴露度高的地点（如山顶公园），对遮蔽型地点（如车站）几近无效，因此部署时应先做场地暴露度评估以判断投入产出。决策相关性得到确认——预警与排班和溢流停车直接挂钩，且天气显著提升停车场预警精确率。方法具备高度的门槛可及性（现成组件、三天冷启动、可迁移至其他气候区的遗产景点如沙特阿拉伯），但结论受限于三个站点、22个月历史数据与回溯性评估，实际前瞻性部署与成本效益仍需后续验证。

title: Do Earnings Calls Help Predict Financial Restatements? Evaluating Text Beyond Public Firm Information
summary: Financial restatements correct errors in previously published financial reports. Could managers' language in earnings calls warn of them in advance? Comparing 109 calls that precede restatements with 218 matched control calls, we find that the text predicts restatements but adds no detectable ranking gain beyond public firm information. A text classifier beats chance, largely because of restatements tied to special-purpose acquisition companies, but a model using only public information scores slightly higher. With refitting, the 95% interval for the gain from adding text (-0.05 to 0.11 AUROC) still leaves room for a meaningful benefit. A large language model scores higher, but we show that it names the exact ticker in 66% of masked transcripts, and it was released after the restatements occurred. Our results suggest that finding new warning signs in call text requires a public-information baseline and a check of what a language model already knows.

AI.tldr: 本文构建109组重述前财报电话会议匹配的案例-对照数据集（109个案例+218个对照），检验电话会文本能否预测财务重述。结论：文本分类器确实优于随机（TF-IDF within-set AUROC=0.628，置换检验p=0.029），但这一信号主要来自SPAC/权证类重述；仅用公开信息（延迟申报公告、审计师变更、公司规模/盈利/成长/行业/空壳标记等）的逻辑回归基线得分更高（0.651），且把文本特征加入基线后排序能力无可检出的提升（Δ=0.000，重拟合后95%区间[-0.05, 0.11]，仍留有实质改进空间）。此外，27B大模型的较高分数（0.665）在很大程度上来自"记住公司"而非读懂文本：其在掩码文本中66%能报出准确股票代码，仅凭公司名与日期即达0.651。作者据此提出金融NLP的三条方法论要求。
AI.motivation: 财务重述（更正已发布的财报错误）对投资者成本高昂，因此学界长期寻找事前预警信号。既有研究已从财务报表（Dechow等2011；Bao等2020）与公司披露语言（Humpherys等2011；Purda与Skillicorn 2015；Brown等2020）中寻找线索，Larcker与Zakolyukina(2012)更直接把高管在业绩电话会中的语言与后续重述联系起来。然而这些工作面临一个被忽视的核心问题：文本模型可能只是识别出"高风险公司"的持久特征（规模、盈利、行业、年龄），而非"重述正在逼近"——即Geirhos等(2020)所称的捷径学习。要判断文本是否带来增量信息，必须先建立基于预测时点可得公开信息的基线。此外，当用大语言模型评估历史事件时，模型可能已"知道"结果，需要检验掩码与知识泄漏问题。
AI.method: 数据：以SEC Form 8-K Item 4.02（non-reliance）申报为重述来源，初采8,903份（2005–2024）申报，通过SEC永久公司标识（非ticker）关联Motley Fool与S&P 500两个电话会语料；取申报前8–365天最近一次电话会，剔除末周（4个工作日申报规则）、剔除同公司前次Item 4.02后一年内、剔除未明确声明non-reliance者；最终109个案例电话会（106家公司）。每个案例按同一语料、同季度（218个对照中192个同两位数行业）、无任何Item 4.02记录匹配2个对照，总计109个匹配集、327通电话会。评估：自定义"集内AUROC"（within-set AUROC，比较案例与其自身对照的排序，0.5为随机），5折交叉验证重复10次，按公司分组避免泄漏；基准信息基线为不读文本的逻辑回归，使用call前一年内两份预警文件（定期报告延迟公告、审计师变更）与公司特征（规模、收入、亏损、成长、公司年龄、行业、空壳/SPAC标记，财务数据取call前原始报告值），缺失值由训练折插补；文本模型为TF-IDF+逻辑回归（固定C=1，不调参），另测FinBERT语气特征与Qwen3-Embedding-8B嵌入及Qwen3.5-9B/27B零样本LLM（掩码公司名、代码、人名，提问未来12个月是否披露重述，取P(Yes)归一化）；Δ定义为"文本+基线"联合模型与基线在同一折上的集内AUROC之差；区间来自匹配集bootstrap（固定模型2,000次；主比较1,000次并重拟合并对每个重采样重新拟合向量化器/插补/标准化/分类器），并做集内标签置换检验（1,000次）；预设决策规则：95%上界低于0.60（绝对）或低于0.05（相对基线）才可判定"有意义效应被排除"，否则报告为inconclusive，并声明基线比较及后续分析为探索性、不做多重比较校正；稳健性设置包括±3年无Item 4.02对照、剔除SPAC相关案例、按时间外推（2019年前训练/之后测试）、Dechow M-score、条件logit、基于披露时距的趋势分析、剔除"调查/审计委员会/内控缺陷"段落、名称掩码重训、掩码名称/代码/大写词/数字/年份的强化掩码、仅给公司名与日期的name-only评分、以及LLM公司识别率与回避性(evasiveness)评分。
AI.result: (1) 文本优于随机但信号有限：TF-IDF集内AUROC=0.628 [0.555, 0.702]，集内置换检验p=0.029；嵌入模型0.583、FinBERT语气0.454（低于随机）。信号在2015–2024更强（0.685 vs 0.464，但与语料混淆）；剔除SPAC相关案例后重训仅0.562 [0.48, 0.64]，不再明显优于随机；权证/权益分类类重述最易区分（0.82，17集，多为2021年SEC关于权证会计的员工声明引发的重述潮）。(2) 公开信息基线略优于文本：基线0.651 [0.573, 0.725]（其中两项文件预警单独仅0.548，说明强度主要来自公司特征）；Dechow M-score单独0.560，加入基线Δ=-0.005。(3) 加入文本无可检出增益：四种设置下Δ均含0——主设置0.000 [-0.06, 0.06]；±3年对照+0.005 [-0.05, 0.06]；剔除SPAC -0.025 [-0.08, 0.03]；时间外推+0.014 [-0.03, 0.06]；以折外文本分作为单一特征加入为+0.009 [-0.05, 0.06]；重拟合后主区间扩大为[-0.05, 0.11]（均值为0.024）。条件logit显示文本分仍有自身关联（每标准差OR=1.40 [1.05, 1.87]），与AUROC结论不矛盾（AUROC只计序）。集内文本分与基线分秩相关0.38 [0.25, 0.49]，基线公司特征仅解释文本分R²=0.05（置换p=0.005）。(4) 掩码无法匿名化LLM：9B为0.592，27B为0.665；27B加入基线带来+0.069 [0.01, 0.13]，是唯一区间不含零的文本增益，但在327份掩码文本中66%报出正确ticker（案例57%、对照71%），217次精确匹配中ticker从未出现在掩码输入中；宽松规则识别率75%（9B为54%），强化掩码（删除所有大写词、数字、年份）仍达63%；仅给公司名与日期即达0.651，name-only分数加入基线后文本增量降为+0.060 [-0.01, 0.13]；且该模型2026年发布，晚于所研究重述的发生。(5) 无一致的"预示语言"证据：距披露2–3年的早期电话会与申报前电话会不可区分（0.569 vs 0.583，差0.01 [-0.14, 0.17]）；各时间窗得分0.66/0.59/0.61/0.57无趋势；申报前电话会中98/109集呈现的正是后来被重述的报表，故"距披露时间"≠"问题起始时间"；剔除显式问题披露段落Δ=-0.014 [-0.04, 0.01]，掩码名称Δ=-0.018 [-0.06, 0.03]；回溯拟合的"公司内异常度"在申报前电话会仅0.439 [0.33, 0.57]（排除0.60以上效应）；回避性评分0.572 [0.49, 0.65]（κ=0.37）；原因编码：股份薪酬0.70、收入确认0.56、资产负债/现金流分类0.50、其他0.54。与案例关联最强的词为 investigation、legal、enforcement、audit 及 cannabis、hydrogen 等新兴行业词。
AI.conclusion: 在109个匹配集上，业绩电话会文本确实能以高于随机的方式预测重述，但这一能力几乎完全可由预测时点可得的公开公司信息解释：在四种设置与两种组合方式下加入文本均无可检出的排序提升，重拟合区间[-0.05, 0.11]仍留有实质改进空间，因此结论为"不确定"而非"零效应"。文本信号主要源于SPAC/权证类重述这一特殊子群，而非普遍的管理层预警语言；且无任何分析支持"语言随披露临近而增强"或"申报前电话会异于公司自身既往电话会"的预期机制，跨集内一致的做法更像是文本在刻画"哪些公司本来就不同"的捷径。作者据此给出三点金融NLP方法论建议：(1) 文本模型必须与基于预测时点公开信息的基线比较，并报告其增益的不确定性；(2) 案例须与规则明确披露的匹配对照比较；(3) 用LLM评估历史事件时，仅掩码名称不够，必须报告模型识别公司的频率与"仅凭公司名"的预测表现。论文同时提醒：重述多为会计差错而非蓄意不当行为，预测分数不应被解读为舞弊证据；局限包括重述事件稀少、样本仅109集且语料偏S&P 500、附加分析标注由LLM生成，且结论限于所评模型与组合方式，更大语料与事件前训练的LLM有望 sharpen 这些检验。

title: Information-Theoretic Design of Sparse Autoencoder-Based Steering
summary: Sparse autoencoder (SAE)-based activation steering is a lightweight approach for modifying the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by adding small vectors to hidden states during inference. However, designing effective steering interventions remains challenging. In this work, we develop an information-theoretic framework for analyzing SAE activations through empirical feature-firing distributions. The central object of the framework is the Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) between such firing distributions, which quantifies how far a generated or intervened state deviates from a dataset-induced target distribution. Based on an analytic divergence response for virtually shifted states, we construct steering vectors toward the target firing distribution. The same divergence can also be used to monitor deviation from another empirical distribution, such as a general valid-language distribution. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the steering in a question-mode generation task study. We further use teacher-forced pulse experiments to show that local interventions induce structured downstream JSD responses in later layers, and apply the framework to a safety-related target--contrast response setting for feature analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息论框架 DESSIRT：把 SAE 特征激活抽象为“特征触发概率向量”，以两数据集之间的 Jensen–Shannon 散度（JSD）为核心度量，在 SAE 特征空间内闭式求解最优引导向量（steering vector），并以“偏离通用语言分布”作为成本项来兼顾流畅度。方法在七类问题模式生成任务（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct / Gemma-2-9B-IT）与安全导向的“目标—对比”响应任务上验证：多数模式下目标一致性优于 SDCV 基线，并可借教师强制脉冲实验诊断单层干预在下游层的 JSD 响应。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）无需改权重、开销低，但有效引导向量的设计仍是瓶颈：既难以挑选真正引发目标行为变化的成分，也难以避免干扰方向与流畅度退化。现有 SAE 引导方法多依赖特征在数据集间的统计“差分”，且常以人类可解释性作为选择依据，而已有研究表明特征可解释性与引导效用并不一致。因此本文将引导设计重述为分布层面的信息论/几何优化问题：放弃追踪逐条下游生成轨迹，改用数据集级（ensemble-level）统计刻画干预响应，并借助梯度与曲率的局部几何性质在 SAE 内部做闭式求解，从而同时获得目标对齐与语言自然性保持两项可优化的目标。
AI.method:
**1) 特征级可辨识性与 JSD。** 设 SAE 编码器 h=φ(W_enc x+b_enc)、解码器 x̂=W_dec h+b_dec。以二元触发 Z_i 与均匀先验的数据集索引 X∈{A,B} 建模，特征 i 提供的平均信息 I(X;Z_i) 在伯努利假设下等于 Ber(p_A,i) 与 Ber(p_B,i) 之间的 JSD，记为 featurewise JSD j_i(A,B)=H_b(m_i)-½H_b(p_A,i)-½H_b(p_B,i)，m_i=(p_A,i+p_B,i)/2。

**2) DESSIRT 框架。** 定义 J(A,Y(α))≡Σ_i j_i(A,Y(α))，其中 Y(α) 为带标量系数 α 的“虚拟数据集”。在 α=0 处做二阶泰勒展开：J ≈ J(A,Y(0)) + α·η₁·g_Y + ½α²(g_Yᵀdiag(η₂)g_Y + η₁·r_Y)，η₁、η₂ 由二值熵的一、二阶导数给出。

**3) 用 SAE 参数评估概率变化。** 以 sigmoid σ(β·) 平滑代理触发概率并做二阶泰勒展开，得 g_Y≃βD_Y^(1)W_enc v 与 ξ·r_Y≃β²vᵀdiag(ξ)D_Y^(2)W_enc v，其中 D_Y^(1)=diag(p_Y⊙(1-p_Y))、D_Y^(2)=diag(p_Y⊙(1-p_Y)⊙(1-2p_Y))。代入后得到关于引导向量的解析二次型 J = J0 + αβuᵀv + ½α²β²vᵀRv，u=W_encᵀD_Y^(1)η₁，R=W_encᵀ(D_Y^(1)²diag(η₂)+diag(η₁)D_Y^(2))W_enc。

**4) DESSIRT-2 算法（有二阶项 + 成本约束）。** 以 v=W_dec z 把优化搬到 SAE 特征空间，得 J̃(z)=tᵀz+½zᵀQz，t=W_decᵀu，Q=W_decᵀRW_dec；在支持集 S 上闭式最小化 z_S*=−Q_SS^{-1}t_S。逐个候选特征 j 做一维消元，得 e_j=t_j+Q_jS z_S*、q_j=Q_jj−Q_jS Q_SS^{-1}Q_Sj，当 q_j>0 时改善量为 −e_j²/(2q_j)，据此贪心选择最优候选。为避免 q_j<0（无界）或 q_j 极小（幅度病态），引入以通用语料分布为参考的同形式二次成本 U(z)=t_generalᵀz+½zᵀQ_general z，以人工设定的预算上限剔除代价过高的候选，起到稳定计算与抑制不自然生成的作用。

**5) DESSIRT-1 算法（仅一阶梯度项）。** 目标为最大化 Δ=−∂J/∂α=βuᵀv，其中 u=½(−u_A+u_B)；在 ‖v_S‖=1 约束下由拉格朗日与 Woodbury 公式得 ṽ_S=(I−νA_S^{-1})u，v_S=c_S ṽ_S；用 Sherman–Morrison 增量式计算加入新特征后的 δΔ 并贪心最大化。适用于小幅干预、可获得大效应，但无法刻画大强度下的自然语言分布偏离成本。

**6) 实验设置。** 目标模型 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，自训 top-k SAE（k=256, D=4096, H=65536，post-resid_post，block 16），7.7×10⁷ 激活向量；跨模型验证用 Gemma-2-9B-IT 与公开的 Gemma-Scope（层 20、31）。七类问题模式数据集由 DeepSeek 3.2 基于 IBMArgKP 生成并经 Qwen 3.6-27B 过滤（每模式 1.0–1.6 万条）；评估用 LLM-as-a-judge 给出模式一致性与流畅度/形式分；基线为 SDCV、SAE-CAA 与 prompt 指令。

**7) 诊断实验。** 教师强制脉冲实验：在层 16 注入 αv，在层 16/20/24/28/31 用各自 SAE 计算与参考分布的 JSD；对比 teacher-forced 与 teacher-then-free 两种条件，考察同一步与下一步的响应。
AI.result:
**问题模式生成任务（Llama）：** 模式一致性随 α 增大单调上升，7 个模式中 4 个最高一致性超过 0.9（M0≈0.70、M1≈0.44、M2≈0.50）；除 M2 外均优于 SDCV 基线（如 M4 0.995 vs 0.935，M5 0.850 vs 0.490）；prompt 指令在 M0/M1 具竞争力（0.895/0.855），其他模式低于激活引导。α 过大时流畅度/形式分下降（仅在分数 >4.0 时连线），呈明确的 trade-off，且平衡点依模式而异（M1、M5 更早出现流畅度退化，作者解释为这些模式在无引导基线下本身较少出现，需更大偏离）。

**跨模型（Gemma-2-9B-IT）：** 层 31 上 DESSIRT-2 全面优于 SDCV（如 M2 0.925 vs 0.595，M5 0.995 vs 0.995 持平、M1 1.000 vs 0.940），在格式分 ≥4.9 约束下 7 个模式中 5 个超过 prompt 指令；层 20 与 31 均有效，说明效果不局限于单层。注意不同 SAE 归一化导致干预尺度不可直接比较。

**下游响应诊断：** 各层（16/20/24/28/31）的 JSD 随 α 平滑变化、呈近似抛物线，与二阶近似一致，且最小化 JSD 的 α 在各层处于相近区间，说明层 16 建立的目标对齐结构在下游层定性保留；下一步（层 16）JSD 与上一步几乎相同，且 teacher-forced 与 teacher-then-free 曲线高度相似，表明干预的跨步持续性有限，实现连续引导需在生成过程中重复施加。

**安全导向任务（目标—对比，D = J(A,Y)−J(B,Y)）：** DESSIRT-1 在 11 项安全指标与流畅度上取得最佳综合表现（如拒绝立场类 S3 4.97、S9 4.85、S10 4.86，流畅度 4.99，均高于无引导的 4.83/4.38/4.76），优于 DESSIRT-2、SAE-CAA 与 SDCV，说明一阶敏感度在小幅干预下更有效。

**特征层面分析：** 在 (p_A, p_B) 平面上，SDCV 选中的高排名特征远离 p_A=p_B 对角线（即仅按归一化差分挑选），而 DESSIRT-1 选中的特征呈混合分布，说明特征“对 A/B 的归属度”并非贡献于散度差型目标的必要条件；对 top-10 特征做高激活片段定性检查，其中 4 个直接对应安全相关内容或合规/拒绝立场标记，其余 6 个更多在上下文管理与人际表达类片段上激活，起到调节对话语境而非直接表达安全与否的作用。
AI.conclusion: DESSIRT 把 SAE 激活引导转化为一个可用 Jensen–Shannon 散度刻画、并可在 SAE 特征空间内闭式求解的信息论设计问题：同一散度既用于构造指向目标触发分布的引导向量，也用于监控与通用有效语言分布的偏离，从而把“目标对齐”与“流畅度保持”统一到可调的取舍中。实验显示该方法在多数问题模式上优于对比式特征选择基线并可迁移到另一模型/不同层，脉冲实验表明中间层干预会诱发下游层结构化的 JSD 响应（而非局限于注入层），一阶梯度项在小幅度干预下最具性价比。作者同时明确了局限：仅验证两个模型，注入层、SAE 维度与稀疏度、特征数与预算均未穷举；评估依赖 LLM-as-a-judge 与自动过滤的模型生成语料，可能引入偏差；并提醒引导方法具双用性，安全方向反向使用可能提升不安全行为，实际系统应配合后处理防护。

title: FlyWheel: Attention Kernels Built for the TPU
summary: Attention kernels on Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) often underutilize their matrix units (MXUs) because of repeated matrix operand loads, vector-intensive computation, and dependencies that leave MXUs idle. We present FlyWheel, a set of fast TPU kernels for both softmax and linear attention. FlyWheel reformulates softmax and triangular inversion to reduce vector work, while coordinating data layouts to improve matrix operand reuse. It then overlaps independent computation to hide execution latency. We apply these techniques to both softmax attention and Gated DeltaNet on TPU v6e and v7x. FlyWheel speeds up softmax attention by up to $4.14\times$ over the state-of-the-art RPA kernel and $1.80\times$ over Splash Attention, reaching 81% of peak BF16 throughput on v6e. It also speeds up Gated DeltaNet prefill by up to $3.61\times$. Integrated into vLLM serving Qwen3.8-27B, FlyWheel improves prefill throughput by up to $1.56\times$ while maintaining comparable accuracy.

AI.tldr: FlyWheel 是面向 TPU（v6e/v7x）的一组原生注意力内核（Pallas 实现），覆盖 softmax 注意力与线性注意力（Gated DeltaNet）。核心思路是把 GPU 上依赖 warp 调度的优化改写为 TPU 上"布局协调 + 降低向量计算 + 显式流水线重叠"。结果：softmax 注意力较 SOTA 的 RPA-v3 最高加速 4.14×、较 Splash Attention 加速 1.80×，在 v6e 上达到 BF16 峰值的 81%；GDN prefill 最高加速 3.61×；集成到 vLLM 服务 Qwen3.8-27B 后，512K 上下文 prefill 吞吐提升最高 1.56×，精度基本无损。
AI.motivation: TPU 上的注意力内核长期无法充分利用矩阵单元（MXU）：主流实现（RPA-v3、Tokamax 的 Splash-Attention）在 v6e 因果 prefill 中仅达到 roofline 吞吐的 18–53% 与 35–73%。原因有三：① TPU 的布局约束与权重驻留 MXU 使数据摆放与算子复用成为核心，重复加载矩阵操作数即使数据已在片上也会限制吞吐；② TPU 的向量吞吐远低于矩阵吞吐，softmax 的归约/重标定、GDN 的前向替换、卷积与归一化等向量工作成为瓶颈，且降向量开销会带来寄存器压力（如 FlashAttention-4 的条件重标定在 v6e 上得不偿失）；③ TPU TensorCore 是单线程 VLIW 模型，由编译器统一调度而非 GPU 式 warp 调度，必须把独立工作以编译器可识别的方式暴露出来。同时，GPU 上成熟的优化（FlashAttention-3 的 warpgroup 流水线、FA4 的条件重标定）无法直接迁移到 TPU。
AI.method:
FlyWheel（基于 Pallas）包含四个相互配合的设计：
(1) 布局协调与算子复用：softmax 采用 head-major 布局，每条 sublane 打包同一 head 的 2 个 token，消除 MHA 下 RPA-v3 的半寄存器填充，使 tile 与 head 数解耦，单次驻留 K/V 加载可服务 256 个 query 行；投影算子直接产出/消费该布局，ragged 边界通过 VMEM 缓冲回拷处理，无需额外 HBM 布局转换。GDN 直接消费投影的 BF16 输出，消除了 GDN-v3 的 HBM 上转与重排；并把共享右操作数的 4 个矩阵乘堆叠为 2 个（如 [βK; Q]K^T 与 [K^T; A_qk]V_new）。
(2) 降低向量计算：softmax 采用"带检查的静态锚点"——把每行指数权重的参考值固定为第一个 KV tile 行的最大值，不再每块做 max 归约与累加器重标定；改用已累积的 FP32 归一化和 l ≤ Λ 作为单次逐行检查（NaN/+∞ 自然触发），失败块在同一次 launch 内用带守卫的锚点更新重放（GuardedReplay），且 |o| ≤ l·max|V| 使输出无需单独检查。GDN 用 8 次 BF16（FP32 累加）矩阵乘的分层三角求逆替代依赖性前向替换：先求 4×4 对角块逆（利用 L^4=0），再按 radix-4 逐级合并（利用 N^4=0 与 U^{-1}=J^{-1}(I-N)(I+N^2)）；因果卷积也被改写为一次矩阵乘 Y = S_conv·W。
(3) 显式流水线：softmax 以距离 1 的软件流水跨 fragment 交错，把某 fragment 的 PV 乘放到下一 fragment 的 QK 与指数运算之后，并把整个循环展开到同一编译器基本块；GDN 利用"求逆只依赖 chunk 输入、与递归状态无关"这一性质，把当前 chunk 的求逆与另一 chunk 的状态无关/状态相关计算重叠，并按 head 分组暴露更多独立链。
(4) 数值安全性：由 l ≤ T·e^τ、|o| ≤ T·e^τ·V_max 与 FP32 范围 F 推导边界条件 T e^τ max(1,V_max) ≤ F e^{-δ}，据此选取范围余量 τ 与检查阈值 Λ = e^τ。
AI.result:
内核层面：v6e 上 softmax 注意力（2K–128K，MHA 32:32）较 RPA-v3 快 3.11–3.49×、GQA 快 1.50–1.73×，v7x 上分别达 3.57–4.14× 与 1.57–1.66×；较 Splash Attention 快 1.10–1.56×（v6e）、1.18–1.80×（v7x）。达 v6e BF16 峰值的 81%（744 TFLOP/s），v7x 达 70%；对照 Splash 的 73%/59% 与 RPA-v3 的 53%/43%。FlyWheel 的吞吐基本与 KV head 数无关（8K 以上 MHA 与 GQA 差异 ≤1.2%）。完整 attention block（含投影与布局转换）在 v6e MHA 下 1K 加速 1.48×、128K 加速 2.95×。全网格 792 个 cell 中 785 个更快（中位数 1.30×）。
GDN 方面：v6e 上 1K 加速 1.84–2.25×、4K 为 2.45–3.10×、8K 以上 2.88–3.61×；Qwen3.8-27B 形状（n_v=48）下 16K 达 9.9M tokens/s（GDN-v3 为 3.0M）；v7x 上 1.56–2.62×，且 v6e 单芯片上比 v7x TensorCore 上的 GDN-v3 还快 2.3–2.6×。
消融：softmax 上静态锚点把吞吐从 582 提升到 720 TFLOP/s，fragment 流水把 521 提升到 720（online softmax 353→582），组合后 353→720；LP LLO 调度器无法弥补（反降至 320）。GDN 增量贡献：协调布局 1.52–1.68×、算子复用 1.06–1.22×、降低向量计算 1.51–1.58×、显式流水 1.13–1.25×，合计 3.19–3.53×。
应用层面（vLLM + Qwen3.8-27B）：RULER 加速 1.07×(4K)→1.53×(512K)，BABILong 1.22–1.56×；v7x 上 RULER/BABILong 最高 1.35×。Video-MME 语言模型 prefill 从 4.80→3.87 s（1024 帧）、11.60→9.00 s（2048 帧），加速 1.24×/1.29×。精度：RULER 与 BABILong 基本一致（v6e 上 RULER 全为 100%），Video-MME 2048 帧两者同为 70.62，1024 帧仅 674 题中差 1 题（71.66 vs 71.51）。附录还给出解码结果：v7x BF16 decode 最高 1.14×、投机验证最高 1.62×，ReplaySSM 使 GDN decode 加速 1.77–2.32×、4-token verify 加速 3.26–3.72×，并支持 FP8 KV cache。
AI.conclusion: FlyWheel 表明，GPU 注意力优化不能直接移植到 TPU：性能上限更多由布局/操作数复用、向量与矩阵负载失衡、以及编译器可调度并行度三者共同决定。通过把三项改造（协调布局、矩阵化重写、显式交错）统一到 Pallas 内核中，FlyWheel 在 v6e/v7x 上同时刷新了 softmax 注意力与线性注意力的内核吞吐纪录，并把收益转化为 vLLM 端到端 prefill 吞吐提升且精度持平。其设计范式——固定锚点+廉价检查+同 launch 重放、radix-4 BF16 分层求逆、把跨算子/跨 chunk 的独立工作显式暴露给单线程编译器调度——为其他 TPU 张量算子（尤其是递归/线性注意力与长上下文 prefill）提供了可复用的优化思路。

title: Towards Fine-grained and Robust Detection of Human-AI Co-authorship
summary: The widespread adoption of large language models (LLMs) is reshaping how textual content is produced, complicating text provenance, and raising concerns for misinformation, plagiarism, and intellectual property. While prior work on AI-generated text detection has progressed, one-dimensional human-AI co-authorship scores lack signals directly relevant to ``AI involvement''. It remains unclear how adversarial paraphrasing distorts detection signals. In this work, we formulate a discrete-class text provenance detection framework. This framework allows an abstraction of realistic co-authorship scenarios into distinct degrees of AI involvement, differentiating the AI polishing on the surface level from the AI updating the discourse structures. This framework reveals the mechanisms of how adversarial paraphrasing blurs the decision boundaries for co-authorship detectors. To improve robustness of the detectors, we augment training data with adversarial paraphrases generated by the state-of-the-art paraphrasing attack model, exposing detectors to challenging meaning-preserving rewrites. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and generation models demonstrate that adversarial paraphrasing substantially degrades detectors trained only on benign data, while adversarial data augmentation leads to consistent robustness gains and good cross-generator transferability. Overall, our findings highlight the value of discrete-class formulation and principled data augmentation for building reliable detectors of human-AI co-authorship.

AI.tldr: 本文（Stevens Institute of Technology，Ziruo Zhao 等）提出"人机共著检测"的四类离散分类框架（纯人类撰写 / 低AI参与 / 高AI参与 / 完全AI生成），标签由受控的提示引导生成过程定义而非事后相似度；并通过使用 DIPPER 对训练数据做对抗性释义增强，显著提升检测器在释义攻击、跨生成器与跨攻击场景下的鲁棒性，基线在 XSum 上从 0.77 提升到 0.95 左右（Accuracy），GPT-5.1 留出攻击下 AUC>0.94。
AI.motivation: LLM 普及使真实文本多为人机共著而非"纯人写/纯机器写"二元分布，带来虚假信息、抄袭与知识产权溯源问题。已有 AI 生成文本检测存在两处未解难题：(1) 一维连续"AI 参与度"分数（如 EDITLENS 用相似度作代理）本质上不可从后验检测器输出中恢复，缺少与"AI 参与程度"直接相关的信号；(2) 对抗性释义（DIPPER 等保义改写）对含 AI 成分文本检测构成高度现实的威胁——轻度 AI 编辑的文本经释义后会被误判为纯人类撰写，但该脆弱性的机理此前不明。作者希望把"参与度"直接落实到生成过程这一可操作属性上，并系统刻画释义攻击如何模糊类别决策边界。
AI.method:
1) 任务形式化：四类离散溯源检测（Human / Low AI / High AI / Fully AI），标签由提示引导的受控改写过程定义——Low 为逐句一对一表层改写（保留全部事实、实体、句长与篇章组织）；High 为允许合并/拆分句段、重组话语结构的重写但保持事实内容；Fully AI 仅给简短引子由模型自主完成内容规划与生成。
2) 数据集：XSum 新闻 600 篇、arXiv CS 论文引言 204 篇、ROCStories 五句故事 599 篇；生成模型用 GPT-4o 与 Claude Sonnet 4；对抗释义用 DIPPER（L=60, O=60），对 AI 参与样本做一次与两次改写，标签保持不变（不作为新类别）。
3) 模型：Longformer 主干（稀疏注意力处理长文本）+ 注意力掩码加权 mean pooling + 全连接/Softmax 分类头，4 类交叉熵（类权重处理不均衡）。
4) 训练设置三档：Benign、Level-1（+单步 DIPPER）、Level-2（+单步/两步混合）；测试在同三档对抗强度下交叉评测；另以未参与训练的 GPT-5.1 作留出对抗改写攻击。基线含 FastText 语言学特征、LLaMA-2 困惑度+随机森林、BERT、RoBERTa。
5) 分析工具：PCA 表征可视化（含 10 类对照设置）、词数统计、Jaccard/BLEU/Longformer 嵌入余弦相似度、归一化 Levenshtein 阈值下的表层可分性、与 EDITLENS 同 RoBERTa-large 骨干的受控对比。
AI.result: 良性同分布下 Longformer 整体最优：XSum-GPT-4o Acc 0.9805/AUC 0.9998，ROCStory-Claude 0.9972，arXiv-Claude 0.9296（明显优于 RoBERTa 0.8844）；特征类基线显著落后（困惑度基线 Acc 仅 0.52~0.68）。鲁棒性：XSum 上仅用良性数据训练的检测器在 Level-1/Level-2 对抗测试下 Acc 崩至 0.7695/0.6652（Macro-F1 0.6367，AUC 0.8988），GPT-5.1 攻击下 Acc 0.6212、Claude 生成侧低至 0.4903 且 High AI 类 F1 归零；加入 Level-1 对抗增强后，Level-1 测试 Acc 回升至 0.9475/AUC 0.9947，GPT-5.1 攻击下 AUC>0.94（GPT-4o 侧 0.9662），Level-2 继续增强的增益边际（呈收益递减）。跨生成器迁移仅小幅下降（GPT→Claude 0.9387 vs 0.9062），对抗增强后仍具竞争力。消融显示对抗样本占比 0→100% 单调提升（Acc 0.7695→0.9475，100% 为最优）。逐类分析表明增益主要来自最易混淆的 Low/High AI 两类，Fully AI 类始终接近饱和，Human 类次之。与 EDITLENS 在同骨干下对比，本文形式化在良性、Level-1 与 GPT-5.1 三种设定均全面占优（重校准阈值后仍如此）。表征分析显示 DIPPER 改写在表示空间形成与真实人写分布相区别的"方向性"偏移而非融入人写流形；相似度分析显示对抗释义大幅降低 Jaccard/BLEU 而嵌入余弦几乎不变，符合"表层扰动+保义"的设计，佐证将其视为数据增强而非新类别。局限性：生成器/释义器覆盖有限，arXiv 数据量小（204 篇）且良性性能偏低，ROCStories 因五句源文限制导致 High/Full AI 长度比达 1.9~2.7 倍（存在长度泄漏风险），且未模拟多轮交替的人机交互写作。
AI.conclusion: 离散四类的过程定义式溯源形式化比一维连续"AI 参与度"评分更贴合内容溯源需求：它能区分"AI 只做表层润色"与"AI 改写话语结构"这两种法律与归因意义不同的协作形态，并提供以写作过程为 ground-truth 的监督。机制上，对抗性释义在语义保持的前提下制造系统性分布偏移，使相邻 AI 参与级别的决策边界模糊，且偏移方向性（非单调趋向"更像 AI"）表明其本质是表层扰动而非新的作者来源。基于此，原则性的对抗数据增强（单步 DIPPER 释义并保持原标签）即可大幅提升鲁棒性与跨生成器/跨攻击迁移性，且进一步增强改写强度收益递减；保留良性与对抗样本的均衡混合训练最优。整体贡献在于任务形式化、基准构建、对释义干扰机理的定量刻画与鲁棒性评估协议，为可靠的人机共著检测提供了具体路径，同时作者也坦承其方法不覆盖全部攻击且可能被恶意滥用。

title: TopoSteer: Topological Layer Selection for Activation Steering in LLMs
summary: Activation steering controls large language models at inference time by adding a vector to their internal representations. Most work asks how to build that vector, and far less attention has gone to where to add it, even though steering at a poorly chosen layer can be worse than not steering at all. Prior selectors choose a layer without ever steering the model to test it: they score how separable the target behavior is at that layer, and how consistently the individual examples point along the steering direction. We argue that what matters is not the separability of the two activation clouds, nor the alignment of individual displacements with their mean, but the extent of the cloud of per-example displacements that mean-difference steering averages. We propose a topology-based layer selection method, called TopoSteer, which scores a layer by the total H_0 persistence of its displacement cloud, computed as the length of the cloud's Euclidean minimum spanning tree. We show that the score focuses on the displacement cloud's relative geometry, while class separation affects it only through standardization. We also provide a theoretical explanation for our method by proving that, as example-level variation increases, TopoSteer and discriminability move in opposite directions, so the two criteria can rank layers in opposite ways. Across multiple language models and steering tasks, TopoSteer provides a principled alternative to discriminability- and separability-based layer selection and yields more effective steering without requiring held-out validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TopoSteer：一种基于拓扑（持久同调）的免验证层选择方法，用于均值差分（MD）激活引导。它不衡量两类激活的可分性，而是用每条对比样本位移向量构成的"位移云"的总 H_0 持久度（即欧氏最小生成树长度）给每层打分，从而在无需留出集引导实验的情况下选出更有效的干预层。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）在推理时通过向 LLM 内部表示加向量来控制行为，其效果强烈依赖干预所在的层：选错层甚至比不引导更差。穷举式搜索需在留出数据上评估 C(L,K) 个层组合，不可行。已有免验证选择器（如 LayerNavigator）用两个类可分性/方向一致性指标打分：判别力 D_l（类间散度/类内散度的 Fisher 型比值）与一致性 C_l（位移与引导方向的平均余弦）。作者指出二者都忽略了真正被 MD 平均的那个对象——逐样本位移云 Δ_l：判别力完全不看位移云，一致性只看方向、对每个位移独立缩放不变，因此丢掉了位移云的"延展/规模"信息。
AI.method: 1) 目标对象：把每对对比样本的逐样本位移 δ_l^i = ã_l(x_i^+) − ã_l(x_i^−)（经逐坐标 Z-score 标准化）定义为位移云 Δ_l，并分解为均值位移 μ_δ,l 与残差位移 Ξ_l。2) 打分：s_l = TotPers_0(Δ_l) = ℒ(Δ_l)，即位移云在 Vietoris–Rips 过滤下 0 维有限死亡尺度之和，等价于欧氏最小生成树边权和（Proposition 2）；可由距离矩阵在 O(N²d) 内计算。3) 不变性：平移不变、1-齐次，故 ℒ(Δ_l)=ℒ(Ξ_l)（Corollary 1），即分数只依赖样例级残差位移的相对几何；类别分离仅通过标准化（Proposition 1）以除数形式进入，可用池内类内标准差得到"去分离"分数 ℒ(H_l)。4) 选择：取 top-K 层，注入仍用原始 MD 向量；另给出桥接占比 b_l = 最长 MST 边/ℒ 作为诊断，用于识别模态分裂或离群点。同时给出同时注入与贪心顺序重抽取两种协议（Algorithm 1）。5) 理论：Theorem 1 证明在固定类均值、缩放样例级方差的同态族中，总 H_0 持久度严格递增而判别力 D_l(σ)=B/(B+σ²W) 严格递减，二者可给出相反的层排序；Proposition 5/6 分析"答案极性轴"（Yes/No 响应 token 造成的双瓣结构）投影后对 D 与 ℒ 的不同影响机制。
AI.result: 在 6 个 Anthropic Persona 二元人格任务、5 个指令模型（Llama-3-3B/8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-3B/7B/32B-Instruct）、约 700 对抽取样本 + 100 条评测样本上：同时引导下 TopoSteer 在 15 个"模型×K∈{1,2,3}"组合中的 10 个优于 LayerNavigator、1 个持平、4 个略低；最大增益在 Qwen-3B（K=1: 64.30→71.77，K=2: 64.16→77.63，K=3: 66.20→79.71），Llama-8B K=1 提升 2.18 点；Qwen-7B/32B 收益较小且依模型而异。顺序（贪心重抽取）协议下排名依模型与打分变体而变，ℓ2 单位球投影变体在 Qwen-3B 上最强。MMLU 变化幅度普遍很小（Qwen-7B/32B 近零），说明对齐增益基本不损伤通用能力；困惑度在部分模型/层数预算下会恶化。与需评估式选择的 W2S-Multi 相比，TopoSteer 对齐略低（78.90% vs 81.25%）、困惑度更低（13.78 vs 14.53），但总时间 8.4 分钟 vs 15.9 分钟。消融显示多种 TDA 描述子中"最优后验配置"在 30 组模型–行为中的 29 组匹配或超过 LayerNavigator（平均 +4.0 点）。附录 Q 指出连接长度对双模态（机制分裂）位移云的敏感性是有条件的，且汇总-范数类替代指标不可靠；桥接占比是稳健的诊断量。
AI.conclusion: TopoSteer 把 MD 引导的层选择问题重新表述为对"位移云"的拓扑诊断，用总 H_0 持久度（= MST 长度）替代类可分性/方向一致性，在无需留出引导实验、无需额外训练的前提下，在多个模型与人格任务上给出更有依据、常常更有效的层选择，且与判别力准则在理论上可反向排序，从而提供互补的选择视角。局限：假设正负样本配对、仅针对 MD 提取器；多层引导可能降低困惑度；Theorem 1 仅针对固定层族，其跨层含义仍是经验性的；标准化引入的稀释效应可能在强分离层上使 ℒ 偏好机制分裂的云，需结合桥接占比共同判断。作者指出未来可扩展到白化/子空间/探针提取器及风格控制场景。

title: Write Facts the Way Models Read Them: Lifting the Two-Hop Curse
summary: A language model that learns a new fact by fine-tuning can repeat it but cannot reason with it: taught that a person is a citizen of a new country, it still cannot say, without chain-of-thought, who the head of state of that person's country is. This two-hop curse is widely treated as a reasoning deficit, and the strongest knowledge editors answer it with synthesized reasoning data. We show that the reasoning is intact and the writing is wrong. Fine-tuning writes a new fact as an answer to be said, whereas the second hop reads the bridge ("that person's country") as an entity, from the middle layers on: patching the model's own representation of the entity into the bridge at those layers largely restores the second hop, yet after fine-tuning the bridge there is no closer to the new entity than before the edit. We therefore propose read-equivalent writing (Legible): one loss term makes the bridge phrase, at the layer where the second hop finishes reading it, match the model's own reading of the new entity, and keeps the same relation's other subjects unchanged. Phrases and targets come from the edited model itself, and no multi-hop training data is used. Across Qwen2.5, Llama-3 and Qwen3, Legible (I) composes learned facts more often than the model composes its own knowledge, on MQuAKE's two-hop-curse questions; (II) reaches 1.8-2.6x the bridge accuracy of CaKE, whose reasoning data composes no better than plain fine-tuning, and has the best average over composition, accuracy and locality against four families of writers; and (III) lifts the curse on RippleEdits, on the benchmark of Balesni et al., who named the curse, and at 14B.

AI.tldr: 本文指出知识编辑中的"两跳诅咒"并非推理缺陷，而是写入（write-time）失败：微调把新事实写成"要被说出的答案"，而第二跳在中间层把它当作"要被读取的实体"。作者提出 Legible（read-equivalent writing），用一个损失项让桥接短语在第二跳读完桥接的那一层对齐模型自身读取新实体的表征，另一个项保持同一关系其他主语不变。在 MQuAKE、RippleEdits 与 Balesni 半合成基准、Qwen2.5/Llama-3/Qwen3（含14B）上，Legible 使新学事实的组合率超过模型自身知识（0.71/0.62/0.63 对 0.54/0.51/0.52），桥接准确率达 CaKE 的 1.8–2.6 倍，且局部性最优。
AI.motivation: 知识编辑中，模型通过微调学到的新事实能被复述却无法被用于多跳推理：例如被告知某人成为某新国家公民后，若不给思维链，仍答不出该国元首是谁。此现象被命名为"两跳诅咒"(Balesni et al., 2024)、涟漪效应、knowing–using gap 等。主流解释是模型缺乏推理能力，因此最强编辑器（如 CaKE）用外部 LLM 合成"电路感知"的推理练习数据，Gao 等自蒸馏多跳问答，Balesni 等在桥接位置加辅助损失，LRSD 把主语中层拉向自身后层。本文主张：推理能力完好，写作方式错误——所有现有补救都只是在选择"桥接该被写成什么"，而正确答案是"模型读取新实体时的样子"。
AI.method: （1）诊断：把第一跳描述写入第二跳提示，在其末 token 处把第 t 层隐状态替换为基座模型对真实桥接实体的读出表征（"This is about o"的末 token），定位第二跳读取窗口（Qwen2.5 为 2–10 层起、24 层止；Llama-3 0–10/18；Qwen3 6–12/26）；发现在中early-middle层注入可将第二跳从 0.03–0.06 提到 0.20–0.26，晚层注入无效；而微调或 CaKE 后桥接表征与新实体的距离在各层几乎不变（0.79/0.82 vs 编辑前 0.70），Legible 则降到 0.16。（2）提出 read–write contract（写入必须产生下游计算所读取的表征），并将其形式化为 Legible：L_LM + w(L_read + L_keep)。L_read = ||h_t(d(s)) - e_t(o)||²/||e_t(o)||²，其中 d(s) 是模型自生成的桥接描述（"the country of citizenship of s"），e_t(o)=h^θ0_t("This is about o") 取 o 末 token，即模型自身"读取"新实体时的状态，而非答案 token 或输入嵌入；L_keep 将同一关系其他三个主语的桥接表征保持在基座位置（一次编辑只改函数的一个取值）。描述由模型五示例自生成，目标为模型自身读出，层 t 由"切断对桥接的注意力后仍保留 ≥90% 正确答案的最浅层"规则统一确定，无需任何多跳数据、外部 LLM 或模板。（3）对照：把 CaKE、Balesni 的 embed-lens/logit-lens、LRSD、自蒸馏等统一写成 L = L_LM + w·D(h(bridge), target)，按目标分轴比较；并在固定损失、层、权重下替换目标（读出、输出嵌入、输入嵌入、他实体读出、上下文教师状态、复制式状态）做消融。（4）评估：MQuAKE-CF-3k-v2（213 个两跳诅咒问题）、RippleEdits（compositionality I/II）、Balesni 半合成基准（18 集×20 事实、1380 题）、Controlled RippleEdit、14B；指标 M-Acc、B-Acc、CR、Nbr/Unrel 局部性。
AI.result: （I）Legible 在 213 个两跳诅咒问题上的组合率超过基座模型用自身知识的组合率（0.71 vs 0.54；0.62 vs 0.51；0.63 vs 0.52），CR 达 0.81/0.68/0.78（CaKE 仅 0.32/0.38/0.37），严格评分下差距更大（0.50/0.45/0.53 vs ≤0.20/0.18/0.27）。（II）FT 与 CaKE 在三模型上无差别（约 0.30），自蒸馏仅 0.34–0.38，说明推理数据只写更多答案；Legible 的 B-Acc 为 CaKE 的 1.8–2.6 倍，并在 M-Acc/B-Acc/Nbr/Unrel 平均上最优（0.78/0.68/0.74），局部性亦最佳（Qwen2.5 Nbr/Unrel 0.66/0.92 vs CaKE 0.39/0.82）。（III）在 RippleEdits compositionality I（0.63/0.49/0.56 vs CaKE 0.31/0.29/0.29）、Balesni 基准（Llama-3 0.49、上限 0.67；Qwen2.5 0.41、上限 0.66；FT 仅 0.17/0.11）、Controlled RippleEdit（0.08→0.34、0.04→0.21）、14B（B-Acc 0.78 vs CaKE 0.42）上均解除诅咒。机制验证：仅"读作 o"的目标能组合（0.71/0.62/0.63），输出嵌入 0.22–0.23、输入嵌入 0.25–0.27、他实体 0.15–0.23 均失败；桥梁表征在新旧实体间的"读作新实体"的层占比与组合准确率在 17 个 writer 上高度相关（Pearson r=0.96/0.86/0.92）；AlphaEdit 局部性近满分（0.93–0.99）但只改第一跳（第二跳被编辑时仅 0.02–0.12）。局限：对答案即被写词的问题（普通微调已 0.81–0.89）几无增益，收益集中在两跳诅咒本身；且需要确定读取窗口层 t 与生成描述。
AI.conclusion: 两跳诅咒是写入时失败而非推理失败：微调把事实写成"要被说出的答案"，而第二跳需要它作为"要被读取的实体"，在中间层开始读取、直至阅读结束；因此关键原则是"读写契约"——一次写入必须产生下游计算所读取的表征。所有现有补救（推理数据、lens 损失、自蒸馏）只是"桥接该写成什么"这一轴上的特例，都写成了模型不读取的东西。按此契约写事实（Legible），新学事实的组合率可超过模型对自身知识的组合率，在三模型、三个基准及 14B 上均成立。结论性主张：会更新自身权重的模型，需要按其读取的方式写出所学内容。

title: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
summary: Anticipating financial outcomes requires synthesizing evolving evidence and reasoning under uncertainty, making deep research systems promising tools for forecasting. Yet evaluating forecasting ability is challenging because historical backtests may reward memorized outcomes or information retrieved after the forecast date. Live forecasting avoids direct access to realized outcomes, but feedback arrives only after events resolve. To obtain timely feedback and assess historical scores, we introduce FinForesight, a diagnostic backtesting benchmark for financial deep research systems. Across the Chinese, U.S., and Hong Kong markets, the benchmark evaluates four forecasting tasks: valuation, return ranking, event direction, and future financial fundamentals. Two capability diagnostic tasks assess counterfactual reasoning and financial calculation, scored separately from forecasting performance. Our harness-compatible framework restricts retrieved evidence to information available at the forecast date. We compare pretraining-era, resolved post-cutoff, and live evaluations to test whether controlled backtests approximate future performance. Pretraining-era scores exceed post-cutoff scores in most temporal comparisons, and stronger retrieval controls narrow the gap between post-cutoff backtests and live results. Forecasting attribution and robustness analyses reveal how scores respond to retrieval policy and how predictions respond to prompt rewrites and numerical perturbations. The code and benchmark data are publicly available.

title: BanglishDepYT: Depression Detection in Native Bengali Social Media with Emotion-Preserving Preprocessing and Domain-Adaptive Pretraining
summary: Depression affects millions of Bengali speakers across South Asia, yet automated detection systems have relied almost entirely on datasets translated from English. Such datasets cannot capture the emoticons, romanized Bengali words, and elongated spellings that characterize real expressions of distress. We introduce BanglishDepYT, a Bengali depression dataset collected natively from YouTube, comprising 191,000 unlabeled comments and 1,000 samples verified through dual bilingual annotation. We propose EPH (Emotion-Preserving Hybrid preprocessing), which converts emoticons to semantic tags, preserves Banglish tokens, protects negation words, and normalizes emotional elongation. A key finding is that preprocessing choice substantially affects performance on informal text: standard cleaning reduces the Banglish Survival Rate to zero (SVM F1: 0.7062), while EPH preserves signals (CESS: 0.9996 vs. 0.6694) and raises SVM F1 to 0.8570, an improvement of 0.1508. We further apply domain-adaptive pretraining (DAPT), continuing SahajBERT pretraining on unlabeled in-domain comments. DAPT-SahajBERT achieves the highest mean F1 (0.8161) and MCC (0.6272), significantly outperforming the baseline (F1: 0.7805, p = 0.0013, d = 1.450) and matching MuRIL (p = 0.589). These results suggest that targeted domain pretraining is a competitive alternative to large-scale multilingual pretraining. title: Efficient Lempel-Ziv Prediction with the Run-Length BWT
summary: Lempel-Ziv Plurality (LZP) is an algorithm of Kosoy that predicts the next symbol of a string by using its Lempel-Ziv factorization, and makes at most $O(z\log n)$ mistakes on every string of length $n$ with $z$ LZ77 phrases. We give efficient online implementations of LZP and of a new variant of it. Our first implementation maintains a run-length encoded Burrows-Wheeler transform (RLBWT) of the reversed history. It implements LZP, uses $O(z\log z\log^2 n)$ bits, and has worst-case update and prediction times $O(\log z+\log\log n)$ and $O(\sigma(\log z+\log\log n))$, respectively, where $\sigma$ is the size of the alphabet. This is an exponential improvement over Kosoy's implementation, whose update time is $O(z\log^7 n)$. We then introduce the Lempel-Ziv Majority (LZM) predictor, which has the same mistake bound and update time, and predicts in $O(1)$ time independently of $\sigma$. These two predictors accept new symbols at any time, without knowing the alphabet in advance. For an alphabet known in advance, a different data structure gives $O(\sigma(1+\log z/\log\log n))$ time per symbol, which is constant when $\sigma=O(1)$ and $z=\mathrm{polylog}(n)$.

title: Adversarial Robustness of Retrieval-Based Fact-Checking: Detecting and Mitigating Evidence Contamination
comment: Published in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. 14 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code and dataset: this https URL
summary: Retrieval-based fact-checking systems ground verification in large document collections, creating a critical vulnerability: adversarial evidence contamination. We demonstrate that factually inconsistent but contextually coherent evidence generated to satisfy both retrieval-similarity and linguistic-fluency constraints can systematically mislead verification models. Contaminating just 3.1-7.4% of training corpora with five label-specific strategies causes adversarial content to penetrate up to 35.2% of top-k retrievals, degrading verification accuracy by up to 46.9% relative F1. Existing retrieval-stage defenses, validated against gradient-optimized or syntactically anomalous attacks, transfer poorly to this threat model: detection rates collapse and F1 recovery exhibits high variance across seeds. We propose GLAD (Geometric-Lexical Adversarial Defense), which fuses dense embedding peer-coherence with lexical distributional isolation. Across two benchmarks, two embedding models, and five random seeds, GLAD achieves the highest detection rates (70-86%) and the most consistent F1 recovery, reclaiming 73-80% of contamination-induced degradation on LIAR-RAW while approaching clean baselines on RAWFC. Crucially, unlike defenses that trade clean performance for robustness, GLAD imposes negligible cost on uncontaminated corpora.

title: GatedV: Self-Gated Values for Transformer Language Models
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, Code and experimental results: this https URL
summary: Standard attention forms query (Q), key (K), and value (V) matrices through learned linear projections of input hidden states. Architectures such as GAU and Mega incorporate nonlinear transformations into attention. In this paper, we propose GatedV, a simple attention variant that applies SiLU only to V before aggregation without introducing additional trainable parameters. We evaluate GatedV against a standard decoder-only Transformer using matched parameter counts, paired initializations, and equal training-token budgets. At 2.33M parameters, GatedV reduces mean held-out perplexity from 59.1 to 57.9 (2.0%), with improvements across all five paired seeds. At 26.16M parameters, following an equal-budget learning-rate search, mean held-out perplexity falls from 20.2 to 19.7 (2.4%), with improvements across all three paired seeds. Small-model ablations show that the tested affine rescaling of values does not fully reproduce GatedV's gains. A short interleaved benchmark on NVIDIA DGX Spark measures approximately 0.7% higher full-context forward latency for the larger model, based on synchronized wall-clock timings. These findings suggest that value-only self-gating can improve language modeling performance without increasing parameter count or redesigning the attention-weighting mechanism.

title: A Capitulation Direction Emerges With Scale and Is Causally Load-Bearing Where Validation Is Strong: Eight Models, Two Families, and Five Measurement Hazards
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Code, data and pre-registration: this https URL
summary: Sycophancy in language models is well documented as a behaviour but poorly localised as a mechanism. We ask whether capitulation under user pushback, the abandonment of a correct answer when a user objects, corresponds to a linear direction in the residual stream, and whether such a direction emerges with scale. Across eight instruction-tuned models spanning 0.5B to 14B parameters in two families, under a pre-registered protocol with leave-one-question-out cross-validation, within-question permutation nulls, and a positive control, we find no usable direction below 7B and a direction that clears our validation gate at 7B, 8B and 14B. Ablating that direction in Qwen2.5-7B reduces the rate at which the model reverses a correct answer by 4.8 percentage points, roughly a quarter in relative terms, while the identical intervention on a gate-failing direction and on a marginally passing one produces no effect. Probe quality, not statistical significance, predicts causal relevance. Behaviourally, pushback destroys three to five times more correct answers than it repairs at 1B and reaches parity by 7B, falsifying our own pre-registered prediction, and a sign-reversing crossover between pushback types survives an order of magnitude of scale in Qwen and holds at 8B in Llama, with marginalisation over five paraphrases per type. We additionally quantify five measurement hazards, including a numerical-precision effect that changes roughly one episode label in ten.

title: EviCast: Forecasting Retrieval Gains Through Shared Response Calibration
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) extends large language models with external evidence, yet relevant evidence does not ensure that a generator can use it. Indiscriminate retrieval can degrade task performance while adding retrieval and long-context inference costs. Existing methods neither determine before large-scale execution whether a generator, task distribution, and retriever configuration is worth deploying nor diagnose multiple candidate retrievers under a shared budget. We introduce EviCast, a framework that forecasts retrieval value through interventional evidence-state decomposition. EviCast measures a generator's response to controlled evidence states once and combines this shared profile with the offline evidence-state distribution of each candidate retriever, yielding the end-to-end net utility and its 95% lower confidence bound without executing every RAG configuration. A state-refinement analysis characterizes when its binary and topology-aware instantiations are exact and when shared calibration is statistically more efficient than per-retriever calibration. In frozen evaluations, EviCast correctly decides all 14 HotpotQA retrieval configurations with a forecast error of 2.75 F1 points while reducing diagnostic generation calls by 80%, and it attains the lowest forecast error among seven predictors in the low-budget regime. Its topology-aware instantiation, EviCast-T, captures the complementarity between terminal and bridge evidence, correctly deciding all 16 configurations on MuSiQue and HotpotQA and 23 of 24 after prospective transfer to a third dataset. These results show that retrieval deployment depends on both evidence availability and the generator's ability to convert evidence structure into stable net utility. title: Diagnosing Model--Item Interactions in Language Model Benchmarks with LSIRM
summary: Language models with similar benchmark accuracy can succeed on different items. Overall scores do not show where their performance differs or which item properties might explain those differences. We demonstrate how the latent space item response model (LSIRM) can help evaluators investigate these patterns and their consequences for model comparison. We analyze 1,348 language models on 5,761 BBH items and compare ways of presenting and scoring answers across BBH, GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and MuSR. We examine LSIRM maps, which summarize differences in performance across models and items, alongside item properties and records of correct and incorrect responses. In BBH, nearby items on these maps often share the same correct answer, such as "Yes" or "No." Across the four benchmarks, this pattern is stronger when answers are scored using option labels, such as A, B, C, and D, than when using the text of the options. We then estimate each model's tendency to perform better or worse on items with particular correct answers and quantify how this tendency contributes to its score. This separates an estimated contribution associated with correct answers from the remaining differences in item performance. Two models' total numbers of correct answers differed by only 14 out of 5,761 items. Excluding the estimated answer-category contribution from their scores moved their ranks hundreds of places in opposite directions, while keeping all other estimates unchanged. The approach helps evaluators identify differences hidden by overall accuracy and understand how the choice of what to include in a score affects model rankings.

title: Tune the Baseline First: Most of Muon's Scaled Weight Decay Gain Is a Tuning Gap, but Its Small Real Advantage Grows With Model Size
comment: 9 pages,8 figures, code and data: this https URL
summary: Scaled weight decay for Muon (Muon-SW) has been reported to train language models more efficiently than constant decoupled weight decay, but such comparisons usually reuse one learning-rate (LR) and weight-decay (WD) setting for both methods. We re-run the comparison under the MAI-Base-2 protocol: LR and WD are tuned jointly through their product for each method, on a source-scaled mixture-of-experts (MoE) scaling ladder (1.9M to 15M active parameters) that holds tokens per active parameter and data repetition fixed across sizes. We find: (1) Most of the gain is a tuning gap. At the shared setting Muon-SW wins by 0.035 bits per byte (BPB), a 1.52x compute saving; after both methods are tuned, the gap is 0.0026 BPB (95% CI [0.0018, 0.0034]), a 1.03x saving, so about 90% of the advantage disappears. (2) The small advantage that remains is real: at the smallest size, all four paired seeds favour Muon-SW at the tuned settings. (3) That advantage grows with model size: across an 8x range of active parameters, the tuned gap rises from 0.0036 to 0.0051 BPB while the untuned gap shrinks from 0.035 to 0.024, so the surviving share rises from about 10% to 21%. (4) The best weight decay moves with scale: the optimal LRWD product grows for both methods, faster for Muon-SW (ratio 1.40 to 1.91), and a law fitted on the two smallest sizes overshoots the third by 1.3-1.5x, costing up to 0.002 BPB. The whole study runs on one NVIDIA T4 GPU; we release the code and all run results.

title: Organizational Learning in Materials Discovery Campaigns: Which Databases, Calculations, and Agent Teams Pay Off
comment: 75 pages including Supporting Information. Code and data: this https URL
summary: More databases can make a materials campaign worse. Through an organizational lens, we trace each source's contribution. One band-gap campaign ranks seven anion families from archived measured gaps, one vote per source. In the first half of its budget, all seven pooled rank worse (rank agreement 0.737; 1 = measured order) than the best pool of three (0.851). As a stability check, choosing the pool on half the runs and testing on the rest kept the gap. Splitting Materials Project afterwards points to its transition-metal oxides and fluorides. Two databases from one pipeline add nothing over one, but pooling gives their shared ordering two votes. New calculations repay their cost early only when two or three campaigns reuse them. Flat language-model agent teams trailed a random-pick baseline (mean 0.876, sd 0.096, 20 searches). An adaptive Al-Mg-Si team, mostly interatomic potentials, was scored on unseen HSE06 calculations. In its first quarter of compute it found 49% of the ten lowest-formation-energy compounds, against at most 40% for fixed teams and 73% for MACE-MP-0 alone. Merging members whose orderings agreed carried most of its gain. This suggests pooling a few sources that fit the measurements, counting each pipeline once and charging for computation.

title: AGiR: Mitigating Gift Over-Reliance in Mixed-Motive Games
summary: In this paper, we consider mixed-motive games (MMGs) which model various real-world multi-agent scenarios where self-interested agents must both cooperate and compete. We identify an issue with existing gifting methods, where agents become overly dependent on incoming gifts and fail to learn reward-yielding behaviors, a phenomenon we call gift over-reliance. To address this, we propose a refusal-augmented gifting framework that balances cooperation and competition in MMGs. Our approach introduces an adaptive refusal mechanism that allows agents to selectively reject a portion of received gifts from their policy-update signals, thereby mitigating gift over-reliance and preventing the agents from being exploited by other agents. This mechanism is gifting-method-agnostic, serving as a plug-in for existing schemes while enabling decentralized learning. We demonstrate that across diverse MMG environments and gifting schemes, our mechanism consistently reduces gift over-reliance and prevents lock-in to sacrificing policies, improving $\alpha$-fairness as a result, without necessitating major changes to existing training pipelines.

title: VERS: Steering Reasoning Models by Editing Their Activation Explanations
comment: 36 pages. Code and checkpoints: this https URL
summary: Reasoning language models write a chain of thought before they answer, and many checks in it do not change the final answer. Natural language autoencoders (NLAs) explain a model's activations in text and rebuild activations from text, and editing an explanation can steer a model at a single token. We study whether such edits can also steer how a model reasons. We build VERS (Verbalize, Edit, Reconstruct, Steer): it turns explanation edits at the doubt points of one reasoning trace into one fixed direction, and adds this direction at paragraph breaks. On the full GSM8K test, VERS cuts generated tokens by 45.8% at an accuracy change of -0.82 percentage points (pp); on MATH-500 it saves 31.3% at -3.05 pp. At half strength, its trade-off between tokens and accuracy lies between those of the published methods SEAL and DEER. With fitted affine maps and a strength tuned for each model, the direction transfers to larger Qwen3 models, up to 235B-A22B, and saves 30-35% of tokens. On competition problems, however, VERS loses 3-7 pp at every model size, and a fixed direction did not separate necessary checks from unneeded ones.

title: Preprocessing Choices in Fine-Tuning Data Matter: Utility and Demographic Sensitivity in LLM-Based Recommendation
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on Evaluating and Applying Recommender Systems with Large Language Models (EARL) at CIKM 2026, November 8, 2026, Rome, Italy
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have introduced a generative approach to recommendation, producing item lists from textual representations of user histories and item information. However, this generative setting raises challenges concerning output validity, prompt consistency, and sensitivity to demographic descriptors. In this work, we investigate how preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior in a generative LLM-based recommender system. We first establish a controlled recommendation pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning, catalog-constrained decoding, and prompt augmentation. We then study three preprocessing choices: item-title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment. Experiments on MovieLens-1M show that the catalog-constrained pipeline eliminates out-of-catalog items and ensures complete ten-item outputs, while prompt augmentation improves prompt consistency and utility. Original MovieLens titles increase HR@10 from 10.67% to 12.47% and Coverage@10 from 41.36% to 47.88%. Fairness-related effects are attribute-dependent: age balancing and knowledge enrichment reduce selected group-level utility gaps while largely preserving utility, whereas gender balancing reduces utility without improving the evaluated gender-related indicators. Overall, preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data should be evaluated jointly in terms of utility, output behavior, and demographic sensitivity.

title: Renormalized Cellular Intelligence: When Does Model Reduction Preserve Collective Capability?
summary: As multi-agent systems grow in size and complexity, understanding which features of their interactions support collective capability becomes increasingly difficult. Can a simpler description preserve both task performance and the measured contribution of interactions between agents? Preserving collective dynamics alone is insufficient: reduction can alter decision-relevant information or give a non-communicating baseline access to pooled observations, distorting the measured advantage of interaction. We introduce Renormalized Cellular Intelligence (RCI), a framework for specifying and auditing capability preservation across scales. RCI treats the task, interacting dynamics, matched baseline, decision interfaces, and resource budget as a joint object of reduction. title: From Single-Agent Self-Discovery to Multi-Agent Adaptation: Scaling Laws of Partner Feedback and Convention Rigidity in Meta Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
summary: A key milestone toward Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) is replacing hand-crafted optimizers with meta-learned update rules (such as Disco103 and OPEN) that discover how agents learn. Yet when a self-discovered RL model trains with adapting teammates, does co-evolution sustain capability gains or trap agents in brittle conventions? Across 1,800+ runs in continuous collective robotics (VMAS) and discrete coordination (Overcooked), we establish five laws of multi-agent adaptation. First, four-cell counterfactual partner swaps expose an evaluation illusion: apparent team progress often masks focal regression (+1.066 team gain concealing -0.119 focal loss) and inflates transfer by +0.649 to +1.210. Second, a 288-run physical-coupling sweep ($\alpha \in [0, 1.5]$) reveals a linear scaling law ($\beta = +0.255$, $p = 0.000488$, Spearman $\rho = 1.0$): live reciprocal feedback keeps Disco103 invariant (AUC 0.297--0.322), whereas severing feedback triggers a monotonic collapse (-0.172 to -0.490), with OPEN establishing a sensitivity spectrum (Disco103 > OPEN > MAPPO). Third, extending navigation training eightfold (1.05M steps) enables Disco103 to overtake MAPPO (+0.087 team return, +0.133 bank gain), while decoupled training boosts cross-partner completion by +10.16% (56.25% vs. 46.09%). Fourth, in Overcooked, MAPPO's self-play conventions induce a 28.13% cross-partner collision rate, whereas Disco103 cuts collisions to 12.77% and achieves 3.33x higher bank return (9.96 vs. 2.99; net gain +6.43), further improved by decoupled meta-adaptation (+1.39 with scripted partners). Finally, perturbation pulses ($p=0.00098$), auxiliary entropy diagnostics (8.485 nats), and 48 multi-lifetime meta-evolved rules ($L_2 \in [2.11, 4.91]$) trace these dynamics to partner-gradient blindness and auxiliary drift, informing multi-agent self-discoverd algorithms.

title: Automated Stateful Specialization for Adaptive Agent Systems
summary: Current automated agent design frameworks produce either static workflows that lack adaptability or per-query optimizers that prevent the accumulation of deep, agent-level task expertise. We propose a new direction that reconciles these paradigms: creating stateful teams of specialist agents that accumulate knowledge over time and can be reconfigured for novel tasks entirely without human intervention. To this end, we introduce ASpec, a framework that manages this full agent lifecycle by first autonomously discovering specialist archetypes via evolutionary search and then cultivating their expertise through experience, mirroring how human experts learn through practice and reflection. We further introduce a lightweight hierarchical control policy, "retain-then-escalate," which governs when to leverage the established agent system versus when to adapt its structure. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that this approach leads to significant performance gains on expert-level scientific benchmarks like GPQA while matching the state-of-the-art on broader domain tasks, demonstrating a promising path toward agent systems that are simultaneously expert, adaptive, and efficient. We will release the code at this https URL .

title: Towards a Theory for the Design of Rules in Multi-Agent Systems: the case of Homogeneous Fleets
comment: 30 pages; A first version of the RDP
summary: The regulation of systems composed of many interacting decentralised agents is a long-standing problem. This problem has typically been resolved by the imposition of rules. Rules resolve the limitations of sub-optimal agents whilst simultaneously aligning the behaviour of the agents with the demands of society. Traffic laws, for example, let a driver cross a junction without seeing around the corner, and transport protocols such as TCP let applications share a network without knowing of one another. The problem is more pressing today, as autonomous systems are deployed in society. In this work, we establish the basis of a system-agnostic theory of rule design for multi-agent systems. We first state the rule design problem (RDP) in its generality. It relates a rule to the set of system performances, defined by the regulator, that the agents deployed under it can attain. However, it is not yet possible to solve the RDP in full generality. As such, we introduce the homogeneous rule design problem (HRDP), in which the agents in each environment are identical, and among other interesting properties, show that under worst-case aggregation the two problems have the same solution, bypassing the combinatorial complexity of the RDP. To solve the RDP under worst-case aggregation we propose Rule Branch and Bound (RuleBnB), an anytime branch-and-bound algorithm. Finally, we illustrate the value of solving the RDP on an autonomous driving case study.

title: Coati: Host-Grounded Execution for Installable Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Mobile GUI agents can carry out tasks across apps, yet most run on a separate computer that drives a phone over the Android Debug Bridge (ADB), out of reach of ordinary users and of the apps through which most people reach Web services. We present Coati, a source-available agent that users install as an Android app. Its runtime on the phone, the host, records what a model alone cannot see: the effect of each action at its target, result screens across apps, and the progress of repeated steps. VerifyLoop checks action outcomes and completion claims against host evidence and reports a completion it cannot audit as unverified. AppMemory builds per-app procedural memory from observations that the interface supports and reuses it on later visits. A routed fast executor lets a lightweight selection model take simple, confident steps and lets the host repeat loops of simple steps that the large model plans once. On all 116 AndroidWorld tasks, with Gemini 3.8 Flash as every agent's backbone, Coati succeeds on 86.5% of the tasks over three trials, ahead of the strongest open-source agent Artemis (77.6% with the same accessibility-only access, 76.5% even when allowed ADB) and far ahead of FinalRun and Midscene (about 59%), and VerifyLoop cuts false completion claims by about a third at comparable success. In everyday use, the fast executor cuts the median time of phone tasks by 39% at comparable success and runs three of four loop tasks 2.8-5.4x faster with 6-9x fewer model tokens, while AppMemory shortens a repeated deep route in an unfamiliar app from 18.5 steps to 6-7. On an Android 16 phone, routed execution completes all 27 benchmark runs with 76% fewer Reasoning calls on the critical path. Host evidence, not model self-assessment, makes an installable agent reliable and fast.

title: Multi-Modal Multi-Agent System for Bridge Operation and Maintenance based on Large Language Model
summary: Bridges are critical transportation infrastructure, and reliable operation and maintenance (O&M) is essential for traffic safety and long-term structural performance. However, bridge O&M faces key bottlenecks: no unified architecture coordinates heterogeneous resources; model inferences lack clear links to physical-mechanical laws; and experts' tacit knowledge remains difficult to formalize. This study proposes a knowledge-enhanced autonomy formalization methodology and apply it to construct the Bridge O&M Multi-Modal Multi-Agent System (BOMMA), which integrates heterogeneous diagnostic actions, physics-mechanics-informed representations, long-term memory, and structured experiential knowledge within a coordinated multi-agent workflow, enabling interpretable and traceable scheduling, analysis, and decision-making. On 3,492 multi-source instructions, the proposed method achieves scheduling recalls of 85.37% for simple and 99.40% for composite tasks, with 95.35% BERT F1-score for O&M action reasoning. Ablation studies confirm the contributions of the components in the autonomy. This study bridges general LLM reasoning and specialized bridge O&M requirements.

title: Cloudra: Geometric Reasoning and Scientific Validation for Autonomous Reaction Mechanism Exploration
comment: 22 pages, 25 figures; Supplementary Information: 31 pages, 2 figures
summary: Autonomous reaction-mechanism exploration requires proposing reaction steps, preparing three-dimensional structures, and determining which reactant and product a computed saddle point connects. Large language model (LLM) agents can misjudge spatial relationships and confuse a computed structure with the species or step they intended to study. We present Cloudra, a multi-agent framework that constrains mechanistic output through a Delivery DAG of chemical objects. Species nodes carry geometries and bonding topology; elementary-step edges carry transition states and reaction connections between species. Cheminformatics algorithms establish molecular identities and atom correspondences. Deterministic routines measure and transform structures to prepare candidate geometries. Frequency and IRC calculations determine the stationary points found and the species they connect. Agents use these objects to test proposed steps, compare pathways, and revise the mechanism. CloudraBench evaluates the framework's end-to-end mechanism-calculation capability across 50 tasks covering elementary reactions, multistep mechanisms, stereochemical competition, and computational method limitations. Across 200 runs under four workflow configurations, the primary Guided workflow achieves a mean composite score of 0.805, compared with 0.584 for the same-model Standard baseline. On Hard-tier tasks, the Guided mean increases from 0.689 under Standard to 0.958. Under Guided, the self-consistency component reaches its maximum score in 24 of the 40 non-Impossible tasks, compared with seven under Standard. Behavioral analyses examine how the agents use bond and dihedral measurements, optimized structures, and IRC endpoints to revise local mechanistic assignments.

title: An Agentic OS Kernel for Flexible and Enhanced Semantics
summary: Modern OS kernels expose general-purpose but rigid interfaces (e.g., syscalls) that are slow to evolve due to compatibility, performance, and security constraints, leaving apps to pay for mismatched semantics and legacy APIs. Existing kernel mechanism customization approaches (e.g., eBPF) improve flexibility but still face strict safety and performance restrictions and thus require substantial expertise. What's more, they targets customized kernel mechanisms rather than kernel abstractions. This paper presents agentic kernel, a new architecture that decomposes monolithic syscall functions into fine-grained, composable kernel-native micro-syscalls, and then enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to orchestrate them dynamically. Agentic kernel introduces a new entry, isyscall (intent syscall), which lets apps submit high-level intents describing their requirements. Then the kernel leverages LLMs to resolve each intent into composition plan of micro-syscalls to satisfy the user's goal. LLMs can further optimize the plan continuously at kernel runtime. To eliminate LLM inference costs on the critical path, agentic kernel caches and reuses verified plans to bypass LLM entirely. Crucially, agentic kernel's safety guarantees are independent of LLM correctness: micro-syscalls follows syscall-level security mechanisms, ensuring OS safety under arbitrary combinations and orchestration. We implement agentic kernel in Linux, called IntentOS, and evaluate it across four kernel versions and three application domains (about ten intents each). IntentOS outperforms baseline Linux in real-world applications, achieving up to 17.55% latency reduction for backend processes creation, 6.97% performance gain for multiple files operations, and 75.52% lower performance impact for frontend Nginx server during memory operations triggered by backend tasks.

title: TenonAgent: Virtualizing Execution Residency for Memory-Oversubscribed LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents execute as long-lived, multi-stage workflows with substantial resource-demand variation across phases. Provisioning each agent or sandbox for its lifetime peak leads to low resource utilization, particularly for memory, whereas aggressive oversubscription risks memory contention, out-of-memory failures, and costly workflow retries. This tension limits the concurrency and efficiency of agent serving under constrained host memory. We present TenonAgent, a runtime system that virtualizes sandbox residency by decoupling the logical agent's lifetime from its physical execution environment. To manage memory oversubscription, TenonAgent employs a dual-timescale control plane. At action boundaries, it combines predictive admission control with a fail-closed, restart-safe contract, dynamically materializing or dematerializing sandboxes based on global memory pressure. During active tool execution, a sched_ext-based kernel gate paces sandbox execution permissions to reduce unexpected concurrent memory growth. The gate provides feedback control over future execution opportunities. Evaluations across diverse agentic workloads show that, under the tested workloads and parameter settings, TenonAgent substantially reduces observed OOM failures and achieves a 100% task success rate in bursts reaching an 8.6x memory oversubscription ratio. Overall, it delivers up to a 5.5x speedup over unmanaged execution, outperforms existing agent-level and cgroup-based schedulers by 5x to 37x, and provides consistent benefits across both Docker and Firecracker microVM backends.

title: Beyond Source Compatibility: WebAssembly as a Stable ABI for ARINC 653 Applications
summary: Thirty years ago, ARINC 653 was introduced to provide a vendor-independent platform for software applications in Integrated Modular Avionics (IMA). A platform is characterized by a well-defined interface abstracting over implementation details; in the case of ARINC 653 this is an Application Programming Interface (API), defined on the source-code level. However, several aspects of this API - such as the memory layout and partially also the integer bit width of data types - remain implementation dependent, so portability across Operating Systems (OSs) requires recompilation, and often also source code adaptation. Our contribution is three-fold; first, we refine the ARINC 653 header file, eliminating remaining ambiguities. Second, building on WebAssembly (Wasm), we define an OS- and processor-architecture-agnostic Application Binary Interface (ABI) at the object-code level, resolving differences in data layout, endianness, and function-pointer representation between host and guest environments. Third, we demonstrate a Wasm-VM-agnostic shim-library that executes ARINC 653 partitions, compiled to Wasm bytecode and following our ABI, on multiple processor architectures using two independent Wasm runtimes.

title: RTP-LLM: Building an Evolvable and Reliable LLM Inference Engine at Alibaba Scale
summary: Large language models and inference techniques evolve rapidly, making model enablement a recurring production task rather than a one-time integration effort. At Alibaba, a shared inference infrastructure must keep pace with new models and serving capabilities while remaining reliable across heterogeneous production environments. To reconcile rapid evolution with production reliability, we present RTP-LLM, an open-source production inference engine developed and deployed at Alibaba. Its architecture separates model-specific execution from shared request processing, state management, and resource coordination. Explicit interfaces localize compatible model changes while allowing models and deployment configurations to reuse common serving mechanisms. RTP-LLM has evolved from an exploratory system into a shared production engine that supports $\sim$100 models and processes hundreds of trillions of tokens per day. We describe how its architecture and production practices accommodate model evolution and contain the impact of failures, and share lessons for building evolvable and reliable inference engines at enterprise scale.

title: MEMENTO: Learning Context Management for Long Context Processing Agents
summary: LLM agents that operate over long inputs must perform context management: deciding what to retain in a fixed-size context window. A common approach is compaction, where the model replaces its history with a self-generated note. Yet off-the-shelf agentic models, including GPT-5.5 and GLM-5.3, often write ineffective notes, and reinforcement learning (RL) alone rarely discovers useful note-taking behavior. We present MEMENTO, a long-context agent built on Qwen3-8B and trained to manage its context through compaction. We first bootstrap note-taking by fine-tuning on synthetic trajectories annotated with notes generated in hindsight, then reinforce it with RL using a reward that combines answer correctness, note-quality heuristics, and confidence calibration. Although trained only to compact into a fresh window, MEMENTO extends at test time to strategies such as context folding and confidence-based backtracking. On book-level question answering across four benchmarks, with books of up to 2.5M tokens, MEMENTO raises Qwen3-8B's accuracy from 36.9% to 67.8% while never holding more than 20K tokens in context. It outperforms GPT-5.5 agent in the same harness (13.1%) and full book context (56.7%) at less than 1/50 the cost. It also nearly matches a ~100x larger GLM-5.3 agent (69.3%) at 1/9 the cost, and comes within 6.4 points of GLM-5.3 full context at 1/26 the cost.
